glossary.example: The ticket costs a lot, but the exhibition is worth seeing.

title: Today's Words (מילות היום)
text: He was carrying a heavy case. It was an interesting case. We traveled to the match together in a comfortable coach. The teacher needs two days to correct all the exams. There is cream on the cake, and she put cream on her face. Customer service has to deal with many complaints every day.

glossary.contextNote: שתי משמעויות: מקרה (in this case) ומזוודה/נרתיק (a pencil case).

glossary.example: We traveled to the match together in a comfortable coach.
The teacher needs two days to correct all the exams.
glossary.exampleHe: המורה צריכה יומיים כדי לבדוק את כל המבחנים.
